name: RC-B10-0567/2025 – Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the arbitrary arrest and sentencing of academics Bahruz Samadov and Igbal Abilov in Azerbaijan
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its opinion and asking Azerbaijan to release two academics jailed on treason charges, Bahruz Samadov and Igbal Abilov, and all other political prisoners. It wants fair trials, an end to repression of journalists and activists, and possible European Union sanctions on officials responsible. It also asks the European Union to keep supporting civil society in Azerbaijan and to make any future partnership agreement depend on human rights progress.

- No law changes; Parliament only calls for releases and fair trials.
- Affects Samadov, Abilov, other detainees and Azerbaijani officials.
- Next: European Union diplomats monitor cases; sanctions and partnership talks considered.
